_comment: Team Rocket Hideout (scripts/modes/rocket.gd, scripts/data/rocket.gd). Open every Saturday and Sunday, plus weekday_days random weekdays each week. Pick a team of three Pokémon and beat three Grunts (three of the grunt teams, picked for the day) and then two Executives (two of the executives) in a row. Each battle is one-on-one, like a trainer battle: you see their team and choose your lead; when a Pokémon faints, its trainer chooses who goes next (you pick between the two you have left; Rocket picks the best type match-up). The Pokémon still standing keeps its HP and heals between_heal of it. Lose all three and the run is over (back to the first Grunt); beat a trainer and your whole team is healed for the next. time_limit per battle: at the end more Pokémon left wins, then more HP; a full tie goes to Team Rocket. Every enemy is a Shadow Pokémon: tougher, hits harder; an Executive brings four Pokémon, and its ace (first in its team list) comes out last, bigger, and gets enraged when hurt.

rewards._comment: Each round won pays round_money x the round number. A full clear pays clear (per difficulty). Only your first clear of each difficulty per open day pays in full: after that, rounds and clears that day pay repeat_share of the money and coins, and no Rare Candy or balls, so the Hideout can't be farmed for cash. The first clear of each difficulty per open day also gives the next piece of that difficulty's Team Rocket outfit (normal: the black Grunt uniform, hard: the white Executive one), in piece_order; once you have it all, an extra ball instead. Your first ever Hard clear gives a Master Ball.
